review_method: Assistant visually inspected every generated PNG; matching PDF pages come from the same Matplotlib figures.

figures.observations: Both legends are outside the panels; 10 distinct identity colors; same points in both colorings. Weather colors are mixed in the ICS plane.
Axes have equal scaling, arrow endpoints are inside the plot and the domain legend is outside. Some changes are very small and overlap at native scale.
All 20 crops render with domain and projection labels. Native small RoIs are pixelated; no invented sharpening. Extremes differ in viewpoint, scale and vehicle appearance as well as lighting.
All 20 crops render; front/side versus rear views are visible across the extremes. Projection sign has no physical meaning.
Legends do not cover data. Both subspace and complement curves, matched-frame identity references and the chance line are visible. In-E energy is only about 3.3–4.3%.
All groups and labels are readable. Clear reference and the chance baseline are explicit; identity energy exceeds domain-shift energy for ICS.
All 16 cells have readable three-decimal annotations with a fixed 0–1 color scale. The most recently adapted domain is the row maximum in only 2 of 4 rows.
